evidence: At 1024x768, the castle-workshop setting, central machinery, counters, shelving, drawers, pipes, and open circular floor are recognizable.
Most ingredient-like objects are very small and densely distributed across similarly styled shelves and counters.
Distinct zones for creature, function or costume, and context ingredients are not visually separable.
No clearly identifiable finished-card reveal area is visible.
The foreground counters provide some open surfaces, but many production surfaces are occupied by small props.
No characters, UI, timers, penalties, quality judgments, unrelated branding, or frightening material are visible.

hardFindings.evidence: The overall workshop reads at the stated size, but dense small props and low differentiation between stations prevent the required ingredient zones and reveal area from reading clearly.

output.revisionNote: Simplify the shelves and machinery, enlarge and visually separate three ingredient stations with distinct silhouettes or color groupings, establish one prominent card-reveal pedestal, and clear more counter space while preserving the open central floor.
